    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        part = line[2:].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
        if ' BY ' in part:
            title, artists_str = part.split(' BY ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs_todo.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print("Unexpected format:", line)
print("Songs to process:", len(songs_todo))
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s['title'], "by", s['artists'])

# Let's write a helper function to find the exact song on Spotify.
def find_song(title, artists):
    # Search by title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, page_limit=20)
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artist_names = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            # Check if all required artists are present
            if all(any(artist.lower() == sa for sa in song_artist_names) for artist in artists):
                return song
    return None

# Test on Tangled Lies

print(song)
